text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek and Narita Taishin are<n>going out to look
for some everyday<n>training shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek asks for my help<n>choosing the right
shoes, so I end up<n>joining them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So why are you tagging along again?<n>I wanted to go
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Oh, don't be like that. It just so<n>happened
that I wanted to go<n>shopping myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We are roommates, after all. We<n>might as well go
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then would you care to explain<n>why your
trainer's also here?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I figured we'd need a second opinion<n>when
choosing training shoes, and<n>who's more reliable
than Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The mall is packed with people. We<n>squeeze past
the shoppers and<n>notice a change in our numbers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where's Taishin?
choice_data_list: Did she get separated from us?
Did she get separated from us?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gosh, what do we do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Taishin... I should've held your<n>hand.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's feeling sad and<n>lonely. We need to
find her right<n>away.
choice_data_list: Let's split up and look for her.

Let's request a lost-person announcement on the
PA system.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll go that way. Let's meet<n>back here later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Taishin! I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek sprints off, weaving<n>deftly through the
crowds in search of<n>Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thirty minutes later...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm so glad I found you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I can't believe you seriously came<n>looking for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You could've just left me to wander<n>around when
we got separated. I'm<n>not a kid.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm a little more out of breath<n>than usual
since I was frantically<n>paying attention to my
surroundings<n>as I ran.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm okay now. Shall we resume<n>together, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Siiiigh... Fine. I'll stay close, okay?Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek smiles with the resigned<n>Narita Taishin
following behind. She<n>appears to have learned
something<n>from this experience.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful idea! We should<n>go and request
one right away!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bing, bong, bing! ♪

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Thank you again for shopping with us<n>today. We'd
like to ask for<n>everyone's cooperation in finding a
lost child.

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Narita Taishin. She has<n>short hair and
was last seen wearing<n>a Tracen Academy uniform.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've gotten the<n>announcement out, I'm
sure that<n>Taishin will—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What the hell was that for?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Thank goodness we've<n>found you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, my butt! What is all<n>this?! Who
are you calling a lost<n>child?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I wasn't lost! I was just pretendingto get separated from you guys!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Really?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well aren't you a little<n>prankster today! But
no more funny<n>business, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I wasn't trying to be funny!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, be good. Here, let me hold<n>your hand so
you don't get lost<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you even listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Narita Taishin droops her<n>shoulders in
defeat and offers her<n>hand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek smiles, appearing to<n>have learned
something from the<n>experience.
